speaker: Vaiangina Sikahema
title: Prophets, Seers, and Revelators
summary: Elder Sikahema teaches that God again speaks through living prophets, seers, and revelators, and that we must not treat their words as a light thing. His main story is his Tongan grandparents in 1947, who sailed through a storm, buried their baby son on the way, and kept sailing just to sit at the feet of Apostle Matthew Cowley. He asks listeners, at the opening of conference, not to take for granted the prophets we can now hear on our phones.
